mapper.select: SELECT exercise_type_id AS exerciseTypeId, body_part AS bodyPart, description, hashtags, card_image_path AS cardImagePath FROM EXERCISE_TYPE ORDER BY exercise_type_id ASC

SELECT ev.video_id AS videoId, ev.exercise_type_id AS exerciseTypeId, et.body_part AS bodyPart, ev.title, ev.video_path AS videoPath FROM EXERCISE_VIDEO ev JOIN EXERCISE_TYPE et ON ev.exercise_type_id = et.exercise_type_id WHERE ev.exercise_type_id = #{typeId} ORDER BY ev.video_id ASC

SELECT ev.video_id AS videoId, ev.exercise_type_id AS exerciseTypeId, et.body_part AS bodyPart, ev.title, ev.video_path AS videoPath FROM EXERCISE_VIDEO ev JOIN EXERCISE_TYPE et ON ev.exercise_type_id = et.exercise_type_id WHERE ev.video_id = #{videoId}
